wanderer__root.title: Summon Horse
wanderer__root.description: Unlocks Summon Horse (Level 3) (39 mana, 28.5 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
wanderer__root.extra_description: Conjure a spectral steed that will follow you around and only let you ride. The horse's speed, health, and jump height scales with spell power. The first skill of the Wanderer base.

wanderer__blink.title: Blink
wanderer__blink.description: Unlocks Blink (Level 3) (6 mana, 2.85 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
wanderer__blink.extra_description: Low-cost, short-ranged teleport in the direction you're moving. Works omni-directionally.

wanderer__proximity_exploiter.title: Proximity Exploiter
wanderer__proximity_exploiter.description: Teaches Proximity Exploiter, an Epic Fight Identity skill: For each living things within 5 blocks of you, regenerate 3 innate power every 0.5s sec. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

wanderer__reservoir_1.title: Reservoir 1
wanderer__reservoir_1.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

wanderer__reservoir_mastery_i.title: Reservoir Mastery I
wanderer__reservoir_mastery_i.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

wanderer__teleport.title: Teleport
wanderer__teleport.description: Unlocks Teleport (Level 3) (22 mana, 8.55 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
wanderer__teleport.extra_description: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, leaving nothing but a cloud of ender energy behind.

wanderer__reservoir_2.title: Reservoir 2
wanderer__reservoir_2.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

wanderer__reservoir_mastery_iii.title: Reservoir Mastery III
wanderer__reservoir_mastery_iii.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

wanderer__natural_sprinter.title: Natural Sprinter
wanderer__natural_sprinter.description: Teaches Natural Sprinter, an Epic Fight Mobility skill: Hold sprint for 1 s to break into a faster run; release it for a burst step, and sprint-jumps carry further. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

wanderer__controlled_collapse.title: Controlled Collapse
wanderer__controlled_collapse.description: Unlocks Controlled Collapse (48 mana, 40 s cooldown) on the ability wheel: a flock of crows circles overhead for a few seconds, then dives in a barrage of bird strikes

wanderer__bird_strike.title: Bird Strike
wanderer__bird_strike.description: Unlocks Bird Strike (24 mana, 15 s cooldown) on the ability wheel: a crow overflowing with energy dives into your target

wanderer__phantom_ascent.title: Phantom Ascent
wanderer__phantom_ascent.description: Teaches Phantom Ascent, an Epic Fight Mobility skill: Jump again in mid-air. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

wanderer__arcane_sustenance.title: Arcane Sustenance
wanderer__arcane_sustenance.description: Unlocks Arcane Sustenance (50 mana) on the ability wheel: turn mana into food, restoring 1 hunger shank and 4 saturation each cast

wanderer__technician.title: Technician
wanderer__technician.description: Teaches Technician, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Dodging just before a hit restores stamina. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

wanderer__wind_jump.title: Wind Jump
wanderer__wind_jump.description: Unlocks Wind Jump (Level 3) (22 mana, 7.12 s cooldown) on the ability wheel

wanderer__spectral_hammer.title: Spectral Hammer
wanderer__spectral_hammer.description: Unlocks Spectral Hammer (Level 3) (18 mana, 2.85 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
wanderer__spectral_hammer.extra_description: Conjure a spectral hammer out from where you look that will mine all connected stone-type blocks in a cube where it hits, leaving only ores and rubble behind.

wanderer__tailwind.title: Tailwind
wanderer__tailwind.description: Unlocks Tailwind (Level 3) (72 mana, 57 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
wanderer__tailwind.extra_description: Imbue yourself with the strength of the wind, increasing your speed and your mobility in the air.

wanderer__immunity_aura.title: Immunity Aura
wanderer__immunity_aura.description: Unlocks Immunity Aura (Level 3) (89 mana, 85.5 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
wanderer__immunity_aura.extra_description: Creates a moving aura that has a chance every 2 seconds to cleanse one random non-beneficial effect from each ally. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.

wanderer__touch_dig.title: Touch Dig
wanderer__touch_dig.description: Unlocks Touch Dig (Level 3) (11 mana, 2.85 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
wanderer__touch_dig.extra_description: Use magic to break a block. Held items affect drops.

wanderer__renewal_1.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

wanderer__renewal_mastery_i.title: Renewal Mastery I
wanderer__renewal_mastery_i.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

wanderer__conjure_refreshment.title: Conjure Refreshment
wanderer__conjure_refreshment.description: Unlocks Conjure Refreshment (Level 1) (40 mana, 21.38 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
wanderer__conjure_refreshment.extra_description: Creates a magical cookie whose nutritional value scales with your Spell Power!

wanderer__renewal_2.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

wanderer__pocket_dimension.title: Pocket Dimension
wanderer__pocket_dimension.description: Unlocks Pocket Dimension (Level 1) (216 mana, 85.5 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
wanderer__pocket_dimension.extra_description: Cast to transport yourself into a personal pocket dimension only you can access, giving a small free range area.

wanderer__emergency_escape.title: Emergency Escape
wanderer__emergency_escape.description: Teaches Emergency Escape, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Dodge even while being hit or out of stamina, and cancel attacks into a dodge. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

wanderer__constitution_1.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

wanderer__constitution_mastery_i.title: Constitution Mastery I
wanderer__constitution_mastery_i.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

wanderer__adrenaline_fiend.title: Adrenaline Fiend
wanderer__adrenaline_fiend.description: Teaches Adrenaline Fiend, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Stamina starts regenerating at once when you kill a mob. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

wanderer__constitution_2.title: Constitution 2
wanderer__constitution_2.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

wanderer__starlight.title: Starlight
wanderer__starlight.description: Unlocks Starlight (Level 1) (18 mana, 2.85 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
wanderer__starlight.extra_description: Summons a glowing star that lights up the caster's surroundings for two minutes. Casting it again replaces the old one.

wanderer__esoteric_step.title: Esoteric Step
wanderer__esoteric_step.description: Unlocks Esoteric Step (Level 3) (40 mana, 4.27 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
wanderer__esoteric_step.extra_description: Teleports toward the aimed position after channeling. A destination beyond the maximum range is clamped along the same direction.

wanderer__silent_appraisal.title: Silent Appraisal
wanderer__silent_appraisal.description: Unlocks Silent Appraisal (24 mana, 15 s cooldown) on the ability wheel: send out a crow that circles overhead; while it lives, creatures around you glow. Drains 3 mana a second while it flies

wanderer__wellspring_1.title: Wellspring 1
wanderer__wellspring_1.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

wanderer__wellspring_mastery_i.title: Wellspring Mastery I
wanderer__wellspring_mastery_i.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

wanderer__bstep.title: Better Step
wanderer__bstep.description: Teaches Better Step, an Epic Fight Dodge skill: A quicker, smoother dodge step. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

wanderer__wellspring_2.title: Wellspring 2
wanderer__wellspring_2.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

wanderer__planned_pack_mule.title: Pack Mule
wanderer__planned_pack_mule.description: Unlocks Pack Mule (30 mana, 120 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
wanderer__planned_pack_mule.extra_description: Summon a spectral mule with a chest that follows you.

wanderer__planned_campfire.title: Campfire
wanderer__planned_campfire.description: Unlocks Campfire (35 mana, 60 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
wanderer__planned_campfire.extra_description: Light a campfire that heals and warms allies around it and cooks food dropped in it.

wanderer__gluttony.title: Gluttony
wanderer__gluttony.description: Unlocks Gluttony (Level 3) (25 mana, 128.25 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
wanderer__gluttony.extra_description: Turn your stomach into an arcane furnace, turning eaten food into mana for a duration.

wanderer__hollow_bite.title: Hollow Bite
wanderer__hollow_bite.description: Unlocks Hollow Bite (Level 3) (4 mana, 11.4 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
wanderer__hollow_bite.extra_description: Devours held food into mana, with unclean foods granting a larger restore.

wanderer__aqua_maneuvre.title: Aqua Maneuver
wanderer__aqua_maneuvre.description: Teaches Aqua Maneuver, an Epic Fight Mobility skill: Swim faster, and release jump to propel yourself through the water. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

wanderer__blind_investment.title: Blind Investment
wanderer__blind_investment.description: Unlocks Blind Investment (18 mana, 15 s cooldown) on the ability wheel: send a crow that blinds whatever it hits

wanderer__almighty_push.title: Almighty Push
wanderer__almighty_push.description: Unlocks Almighty Push (Level 3) (36 mana, 21.38 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
wanderer__almighty_push.extra_description: Create a area of wind around you knocking back creatures in every directions, causing damage if they impact a wall
